# Vitesse Energy Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date and Conference Call


October 15, 2026 4:06pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_a834b43e025fac2520859348778355be/vitesseoil/news/2026-10-15_Vitesse_Energy_Announces_Third_Quarter_2026_58.pdf)


GREENWOOD VILLAGE, Colo.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Vitesse Energy, Inc. (NYSE: VTS) (“Vitesse” or the “Company”) today announced that it plans to issue its third quarter 2026 financial and operating results on Monday, November 2, 2026, after market close. Additionally, the Company will host a conference call on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time.


Those wishing to listen to the conference call may do so via phone or the Company’s webcast.


**Conference Call and Webcast Details:**
Date: November 3, 2026
Time: 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time
Dial-In: 877-407-0778
International Dial-In: +1 201-689-8565
Conference ID: 13763059
Webcast:[https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=3TpSzvYW](https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=3TpSzvYW)


**Replay Information:**
A replay of the conference call will be available through November 10, 2026, by dialing:
Dial-In: 877-660-6853
International Dial-In: +1 201-612-7415
Conference ID: 13763059


**ABOUT VITESSE ENERGY, INC.**


Vitesse Energy, Inc. is focused on returning capital to stockholders through owning financial interests predominantly as a non-operator in oil and gas wells drilled by leading U.S. operators.


More information about Vitesse can be found at[www.vitesse-vts.com](https://www.vitesse-vts.com/) .
